name: mission_health
description: Mission-level silent-failure flag from real kit event mis-M001 (training mission M001): reported COMPLETED although 2 of 10 actions failed and a HIGH VISUAL_DEFECT was raised on Heat Exchanger 08. Demonstrates kind mission / category mission_health. All numbers computed from amd/system1/data/kit with triage.policy 2026-10-10.1.

reasons.text: Reported COMPLETED but 2 of 10 actions failed
1 HIGH anomaly: VISUAL_DEFECT on Heat Exchanger 08

evidence.claim: M001 reported COMPLETED, but 2 of its 10 actions failed.
Step 9 on Heat Exchanger 08 failed with SENSOR_TIMEOUT and raised a HIGH VISUAL_DEFECT.
Step 1 navigation at WP05 failed with OBSTACLE_DETECTION.
This pattern is common: 21 of the 26 kit missions reported COMPLETED had at least one failed action.

explanation.answer: No. The COMPLETED status is misleading. Send a technician to Heat Exchanger 08 at WP03 Cooling Loop for the HIGH defect that the mission summary hides.
explanation.question: Did mission M001 really complete cleanly?

event.text: Mission M001 Autowalk Inspection Route 01: reported COMPLETED after 31 min, battery 82% to 15%, 10 actions with 2 failed; anomalies LOW 1, HIGH 1.
Action A0001, step 1: NAVIGATION FAILED with OBSTACLE_DETECTION after 67 s at battery 75% on HX-201 Heat Exchanger 01 at WP05.
Action A0009, step 9: VISUAL_INSPECTION FAILED with SENSOR_TIMEOUT after 61 s at battery 22% on HX-208 Heat Exchanger 08 at WP03; anomaly AN009 VISUAL_DEFECT severity HIGH.

facts.text: A mission reported COMPLETED with failed actions and a HIGH anomaly is misleading and gets P2 under policy 2026-10-10.1.
21 of the 26 kit missions reported COMPLETED have at least one failed action (27 kit missions in total).
